prompt: The receptionist says our Geneva office (not / to have) a lift.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол says стоит в Present Simple, поэтому сдвига времён в придаточном предложении нет.

prompt: Our Dublin shop owner explains that the shop (to close) on Sundays.
explanation_ru: Глагол explains стоит в настоящем времени, а расписание остаётся постоянным, поэтому время не сдвигается.

prompt: In Auckland, the worker tells me the dogs (to sleep) in the warm shed.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола tells в Present Simple время в косвенной речи сохраняется.

prompt: A bookseller in Manila mentions the shop (to give) students ten per cent off.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол mentions стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому глагол gives остаётся в Present Simple.

prompt: At the planetarium, the speaker told us Mars (to have) two small moons.
explanation_ru: Это общеизвестный научный факт, поэтому даже после глагола told в прошедшем времени сдвиг не нужен.

prompt: Mateo's instructor says the written driving test (to be) in both Spanish and English.
explanation_ru: Глагол says употреблён в Present Simple, поэтому форма is не переходит в прошедшее время.

prompt: We worried about break-ins at our Auckland shop. The security guard assured us the cameras (to record) the entrance day and night.
explanation_ru: Факт остаётся актуальным и сейчас, поэтому после глагола assured допустимы оба варианта: без сдвига (record) и со сдвигом (recorded).

prompt: Reporters waited in Florida. An engineer has just confirmed the rocket won't leave yet and still (to stand) on the launch pad.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол has just confirmed стоит в Present Perfect, поэтому сдвиг времени в придаточном предложении не делается.

prompt: Did you hear what the Quito clinic receptionist just said? She says the doors still (to open) at six every morning.
explanation_ru: Во втором предложении используется вводный глагол says в Present Simple, поэтому время остаётся настоящим.

prompt: Last week, our coding teacher in Nairobi told Priya she (to fix) the broken login page before class.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о завершённом прошлом действии до урока, поэтому после told нужен сдвиг в Past Perfect (с предлогом before также допустим Past Simple).

prompt: Zofia didn't like dark streets in Cape Town. Luckily, the coordinator wrote that the street lights (to stay) on until five.
explanation_ru: Уличные фонари продолжают работать по тому же расписанию, поэтому после wrote возможны как stay, так и stayed.

prompt: In his online review of a Berlin music shop, Lukas wrote that the staff still (to know) every album by heart, even though the narrow street outside (to look) quite empty that afternoon.
explanation_ru: Знание альбомов остаётся актуальным фактом (know или knew), а вид улицы относится к конкретному прошлому дню, поэтому здесь обязателен сдвиг в looked.

prompt: When we toured Lisbon, our guide explained that the coastal fort still (to stand) by the river, though the small café inside (to be) closed for repairs that week.
explanation_ru: Крепость стоит на месте и сейчас, поэтому допустимы stands и stood, а временное закрытие кафе на той неделе требует прошедшего времени was.

prompt: Before the Manchester match, the radio announcer has just reminded fans that the local council still (to own) the stadium, although earlier rumours claimed a rich investor (to want) to buy it.
explanation_ru: После has just reminded в Present Perfect сдвига нет (owns), а после прошедшего глагола claimed о прежних слухах требуется сдвиг в wanted.

prompt: Yusuf starts his new job at a small garage in Buenos Aires. The boss tells him the garage always (to close) at noon on Saturdays. Yesterday, Yusuf didn't know that, and a friendly customer told him the whole street usually (to go) quiet by lunchtime.
explanation_ru: После tells в настоящем времени используется только closes; после told о постоянном явлении допустимы и goes, и went.

prompt: We didn't expect much on our winter trip to Brighton. We had worried the famous corner bakery might be shut in winter. When we arrived, the guesthouse owner smiled and told us the bakery still (to bake) fresh bread all year round. She also promised we (will / to smell) the warm loaves from our bedroom window in the morning.
explanation_ru: Постоянная работа пекарни допускает отсутствие сдвига (bakes) или сдвиг (baked), а обещание о следующем утре требует сдвига will в would.

prompt: Kenji and his wife walked into a tiny riverside restaurant in Hanoi. They asked why the noodle soup tasted so rich and sweet. The owner laughs whenever guests ask and explains that the soup (to cook) slowly for eight hours before sunrise. When they left, he told them his family still (to use) the same old recipe, and Kenji promised he (will / to bring) his friends back next time.
explanation_ru: После explains в настоящем времени используется cooks, для сохраняющейся традиции после told возможны uses и used, а после promised глагол will меняется на would.

prompt: Mei waited at a windy corner in Istanbul for nearly half an hour. Finally, a local shopkeeper walked over and noticed she looked completely lost. He pointed across the square and told her the old red tram still (to run) to the centre every twenty minutes. He added that she (to wait) on the wrong side of the road and (can / to catch) the next one from the opposite stop.
explanation_ru: Постоянное расписание трамвая допускает runs или ran, а действия в тот конкретный момент в прошлом требуют сдвига в was waiting и could catch.

prompt: Sofia went to the print workshop in Mexico City because the old press wasn't working last week. Good news: the workshop leader has just messaged the group that the machine (to work) properly again and that the team (can / to print) the posters this afternoon. Earlier today, though, Sofia told me she (to think) the exhibition would be cancelled.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол has just messaged стоит в Present Perfect, поэтому is working и can print не сдвигаются; прошлое опасение после told me требует прошедшей формы thought.

prompt: Outside a busy taxi rank in Cairo, Owen and his sister climbed into the first cab in the queue. Before setting off, the driver warned them his meter (to stop) working that morning, so they needed to agree on a fair price first. Owen politely replied that he (to check) the usual airport fare online earlier. Nowadays, Owen always tells friends that Cairo drivers (to respect) travellers who negotiate calmly with a smile.
explanation_ru: События до поездки после warned и replied требуют сдвига в прошедшее время (had stopped, had checked), а после tells в Present Simple время не меняется (respect).

prompt: Five old classmates met for a reunion dinner in Munich after fifteen years apart. Over dessert, Tariq reminded everyone that their tiny first-floor classroom still (to face) the stone bridge across the canal. Elena laughed and admitted she (not / to recognise) half the shops on that street when she walked past. Before they said goodbye, she insisted that the town never truly (to lose) its charm, no matter how much it changes.
explanation_ru: Расположение класса до сих пор верно (faces/faced), случай на прогулке требует сдвига в прошлое, а общее убеждение с частью в настоящем времени (changes) сохраняет Present Simple (loses).

prompt: Heavy rain drove our tour group under the entrance arch of a historic school in Edinburgh. While we shook out our umbrellas, the guide explained that the school still (to open) its heavy wooden doors to local children each morning. She pointed up to the tower and added that the brass clock (to keep) perfect time for ninety years without a single breakdown. Amara later remarked that she (to enjoy) that unexpected shelter more than the castle itself.
explanation_ru: Для фактов, верных и сегодня, после explained и added возможны формы без сдвига и со сдвигом (opens/opened, has kept/had kept), а впечатление о прошедшем визите требует had enjoyed или enjoyed.

prompt: Does the Berlin lab open on Mondays? The student says it ___ closed.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому нужен Present Simple (is); частая ошибка — автоматически ставить was.

prompt: On the Faroe Islands, a farmer tells visitors the wind ___ always strong.
explanation_ru: После глагола tells в Present Simple время не сдвигается; типичная ошибка — выбирать was по привычке к косвенной речи.

prompt: We joined a Hamburg boat tour. The guide explained the city ___ the largest port in Germany, so ships arrive daily.
explanation_ru: Это постоянный географический факт, связанный с настоящим (arrive daily), поэтому нужен Present Simple (is), а не ошибочный сдвиг в was.

prompt: Did Barcelona reopen the stadium? No, today's report has announced that the away section ___ ready because of repairs.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол has announced стоит в Present Perfect, поэтому сдвиг в прошедшее время (was not) является ошибкой.

prompt: Years ago, a local resident in Quito told my grandfather that the old white church ___ the tallest building in the valley, though modern office blocks stand much higher today.
explanation_ru: Факт больше не соответствует действительности (сегодня выше офисные здания), поэтому оставлять is нельзя — нужен сдвиг в was.

prompt: The border guard says the crossing was always closed at night.
answer: The border guard says the crossing is always closed at night.
accepted_answers: The border guard says the crossing is always closed at night.
The border guard says that the crossing is always closed at night.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола says в Present Simple время не сдвигается; ошибка — менять is на was.

prompt: In their Buenos Aires flat, Carlos's mother reminded him that his grandmother still lives in the little house by the river.
answer: In their Buenos Aires flat, Carlos's mother reminded him that his grandmother still lives in the little house by the river.
accepted_answers: In their Buenos Aires flat, Carlos's mother reminded him that his grandmother still lives in the little house by the river.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: бабушка до сих пор живёт в том доме, поэтому после reminded глагол lives правомерно остаётся в Present Simple.

prompt: The Stockholm designer has told our team that the blue logo still worked best on small phone screens.
answer: The Stockholm designer has told our team that the blue logo still works best on small phone screens.
accepted_answers: The Stockholm designer has told our team that the blue logo still works best on small phone screens.
The Stockholm designer has told our team the blue logo still works best on small phone screens.
explanation_ru: После глагола has told в Present Perfect и наречия still сдвиг в прошедшее время (worked) неверен — нужен Present Simple (works).

prompt: Inside the main hall in Buenos Aires, the guide explained to two families that the building had been the oldest museum in the country, which is why it still draws huge crowds.
answer: Inside the main hall in Buenos Aires, the guide explained to two families that the building is the oldest museum in the country, which is why it still draws huge crowds.
accepted_answers: Inside the main hall in Buenos Aires, the guide explained to two families that the building is the oldest museum in the country, which is why it still draws huge crowds.
explanation_ru: Здание до сих пор остаётся старейшим музеем страны, поэтому Past Perfect (had been) ошибочно показывает факт как завершённый в прошлом — здесь нужно is.

prompt: Freya is reading an online review of a Tokyo karaoke bar aloud to her friends: "This place stays open until four in the morning."
options: Freya says the karaoke bar stayed open until four in the morning.
Freya says the karaoke bar stays open until four in the morning.
Freya said the karaoke bar had stayed open until four in the morning.
Freya says the karaoke bar would stay open until four in the morning.
explanation_ru: Речь передаётся в момент чтения через глагол says в настоящем времени, поэтому stays не сдвигается в прошедшее время.

prompt: A travel writer visits a family tea house in Istanbul. The owner pours tea and remarks proudly that the shop has never moved from the spot where his great-grandfather first opened it.
options: The owner told the writer that the tea house had once stood where his great-grandfather opened it.
The owner explains to the writer that the tea house had stood where his great-grandfather opened it.
The owner told the writer that the tea house still stands where his great-grandfather opened it.
The owner explained that the tea house will still stand where his great-grandfather had opened it.
explanation_ru: Только вариант со still stands точно передаёт, что чайная по-прежнему находится на том же месте; формы had stood искажают смысл.

prompt: Father reminds his children, "Our village is famous for its old stone bridge." → Father reminds his children …
answer: Father reminds his children that their village is famous for its old stone bridge.
accepted_answers: Father reminds his children that their village is famous for its old stone bridge.
Father reminds his children their village is famous for its old stone bridge.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол reminds стоит в Present Simple, поэтому is не меняется, но местоимение our переходит в their.

prompt: The museum guide in Berlin has told the school group, "The giant whale skeleton still hangs above the main hall." → The museum guide in Berlin has told the school group …
answer: The museum guide in Berlin has told the school group that the giant whale skeleton still hangs above the main hall.
accepted_answers: The museum guide in Berlin has told the school group that the giant whale skeleton still hangs above the main hall.
The museum guide in Berlin has told the school group the giant whale skeleton still hangs above the main hall.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола has told в Present Perfect время в косвенной речи не сдвигается, поэтому hangs сохраняется.
